summaries.summary: This extension exhibits clear signs of a malicious info-stealer disguised as a code coverage tool. It harvests sensitive system information (hostname, username, CPU, MAC addresses) and attempts to steal OAuth tokens from Microsoft and GitHub accounts. This data is exfiltrated to an external PHP endpoint using a hardcoded API key. The capabilities are completely disproportionate to the stated purpose of analyzing code coverage files, indicating a high-confidence malicious intent.

The code chunk is from a commercial VS Code extension for code coverage visualization. The behavior is consistent with the extension's advertised functionality. No malicious intent, credential theft, or unauthorized command execution was identified in this chunk.

There is no evidence of credential harvesting, system fingerprinting, or malicious payload execution in this specific chunk.
